roundup.text:
Subtensor has merged proxy and basket-minting security fixes into release-487. Our finalized check still shows runtime 486.

A code merge, deployment and on-chain execution are separate milestones.

Also in today’s Bittensor report:

• SN65 TPN: a published 2.32 GB model, with Gratis support reported by the team.
• SN36 Weir: a verified identity and public GPU-rental site/code.
• SN75 Hippius: a team-reported 1 PB stored.
• SN91 Cascade: its connections with SN118 Ditto, SN4 Targon, SN6 Numinous and SN51 Lium.
• SN44 Score and SN31 rec4ll: exact overnight reward-allocation changes.

Sources, actual dates and verification gaps, plus the completed TPN interview:
https://shizzyunchained.com/subnet-news/2026-11-04
